sources.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: small product thumbnail for a business dashboard. Primary request: create a crisp photorealistic catalog product illustration of a single compact handheld electric body massager, white ergonomic body, two soft rounded gray massage nodes, small dark unlabelled control panel. White seamless studio background, centered complete product occupying about 85% of the square image, soft neutral lighting, subtle soft shadow, sharp product edges and fine material detail. This is a generic illustrative product, not a replica of a named commercial model. Absolutely no branding, no logos, no text, no marketing graphics, no people, no watermark, no extra accessories beyond those described.
